acceptance: 1) Only in isolation, run the existing build-offbox/import-and-scan and deploy-script flow and verify image manifest/SHA/platform. Record exact versions, commands and results for backup, Prisma diff, plan-check, db push without accept-data-loss, zero drift, standalone startup, and home computed-style/real-request/event smoke. Do not add a hosting platform or change the distribution scheme. 2) Restore a real backup into disposable PostgreSQL and read it through the app; verify old-image compatibility/rollback and credential invalidation. Read-only checks must show actual backup-completion/restore-verification metadata matching ops-report/stats. If no verifiable backup source exists, it must be not_connected; file presence or scheduled time cannot masquerade as successful backup or recoverability. Do not add a backup platform or upload backup contents (E-65). 3) Collect same-head visitor/session/recovery/analytics/operations evidence and unresolved items. Distribution artifacts exclude protected backups and secrets; no automatic production merge/deployment/cleanup or purchase.

E-65.scene: Additional operations metrics and role permissions
E-65.trigger: Storage health or backups lack a verifiable source
E-65.expect: Show only not connected and source state. Once connected, show actual check/completion times; do not use ordinary file uploads, successful page queries or scheduled times to fake backup success, and do not silently add a backup platform or paid service.
